subject: 106 Alexander Variance Application
overview: The board voted to continue its sole hearing, a variance application for 106 Alexander, to February 26, 2026, and discussed administrative staffing updates including the chair's upcoming departure.

items.title: 106 Alexander (Case 25-00026)
items.summary: Approved a continuance of the variance hearing to demolish a single-family home to February 26, 2026, allowing staff time to review late-filed parking analysis materials.

items.title: Administrative Updates
items.summary: Staff provided updates on medical leave and upcoming caseloads, and Chair Mike Caldera announced he will step down from the board after the March meeting.
